card.name: Step numbers and procedure references
card.fires_on: Step numbers after 'repeat step' and small words in instruction or method statements, where the next word is likely 'procedure' or a procedural reference.

modes.label: Step numbers
modes.description: The number after 'repeat step(s)' in preparation instructions.
modes.example: Repeat step <<3>> until all of the mixture is administered.

modes.label: Method or rule openers
modes.description: A small word that begins a statement about a test method or a rule and points to what follows.

modes.description: A linking word before a pointer to another section or table.
